implied_expectations.interpretation: The market price does not require an implausible bull case, but it does require long-duration double-digit revenue growth and a recovery from roughly 12% TTM FCF margin to 20%-24% despite unprecedented AI capital intensity and potential dilution.

bear.description: Search growth slows materially, AI capex remains structurally heavy, Cloud competes on price and FCF margin recovers only modestly.

base.description: Search monetization remains resilient, Cloud and AI sustain strong growth, and FCF margin normalizes after the infrastructure build without perfect execution.

bull.description: Alphabet's full-stack AI position drives Search expansion, Cloud leadership, high utilization and strong FCF conversion, while dilution remains contained.

drivers: Structural Search advertising erosion and loss of distribution advantages
Cloud price competition and underutilized AI capacity
FCF margin stuck near 12%-15% despite elevated depreciation and financing costs
permanent_loss_case.nature_of_loss: A long-duration failure to earn the cost of capital and irreversible opportunity cost, not a near-term bankruptcy case.

notes: All scenario outputs are estimates, not facts. Ten-year annual DCF uses year-end cash-flow discounting. Net financial assets equal June 2026 cash and short-term marketable securities less June long-term debt and preferred liquidation value; the August 2026 $25 billion debt issue is discussed separately because a matching post-issue cash balance is unavailable. Non-marketable securities are recognized with scenario-specific haircuts. Current displayed P/E is distorted by large unrealized equity gains. GOOG and GOOGL have the same operating value, but the observed class price spread should be applied at trade time.
